findings.rationale: Backup names use only the process ID and index. If hard_link fails because a later backup path already exists, the cleanup loop removes every computed backup path, including the pre-existing path that this invocation did not create. PID reuse after an interrupted migration can therefore delete a stale or user-owned file.

find_comparator iterates byte offsets but slices s[i..] at every offset. A non-ASCII character before the comparator produces a non-character-boundary slice and panics, so the public parse_ai_project Result API can abort on untrusted requirement text instead of returning a parse error.

unparsed_clauses emits all statistical-property clauses before all observed-property clauses because declarations are stored in separate vectors. parse_checked_ai_project nevertheless treats the first result as the earliest source occurrence, so interleaved declarations can report the location of a later malformed clause.

A completion without a pending request, or a duplicate irreversible completion, only appends a finding. Execution then still calls domain_replay_step and updates completed, pending, and observed. If the lowered model accepts that transition, an invalid duplicate mutates replay state and contaminates subsequent validation and final_state despite the explicit at-most-once check.
